summary: The diff implements Array.of in crates/kahvi-builtins/src/array/of.rs and follows all nine spec steps in order. Step 4 checks IsConstructor and calls Construct with «lengthNumber», and step 5 calls ArrayCreate(length). The loop does CreateDataPropertyOrThrow per index with `?`, and step 8 does Set(array, "length", lengthNumber, true) with `?`. Every fallible operation propagates its error with `?`. There are no test-keyed branches, no hardcoded values, and no unimplemented paths returning made-up values. The only non-step change is renaming the unused `new_target` parameter to `_new_target`, which is fine. I could not see the signatures of ops::construct, ops::is_constructor, array_create or key_from_index, so I am assuming they match how they are called. The gate report shows 24 new passes and no regressions.
